name: Bundle of Wood
label: Item
description: Near Eastvale Logging Camp, Bundle of Wood waits in the trees for an urgent shipment west.
intro: Near Eastvale Logging Camp, Bundle of Wood waits in the trees for an urgent shipment west.

p: Freshly chopped timber from Eastvale Logging Camp helps supply the Kingdom of Stormwind. The camp sends wood west for town buildings and other construction. Bears and wolves have pushed into the groves northwest of camp, and terrified loggers fled, leaving their freshly gathered Bundles of Wood among the trees. With delivery deadlines close, overseer Raelen needs travelers to pass the predators and recover the timber before the lumber contracts are breached.
